name: Synjax
description: Synjax was a paradise planet renowned for its pristine beaches. In 4 ABY, Synjax was the final destination of the first voyage of the star cruiser Halcyon after it had been liberated from the Galactic Empire. The individual Kelad was supposed to meet a buyer for his Thermal oscillator design on the planet.
